title: Build a Hermetic News Client Suite
prompt: Test the Week 16 news client end to end through MockWebServer for success, conditional request, empty body, typed errors, malformed JSON, timeout, retry, cancellation, and log redaction.
successCriteria: No test reaches the public internet.
Recorded requests verify path, query, and safe headers.
Adverse responses map to exact typed outcomes.
hints: Write down the ownership and failure contract before choosing library APIs.
Prove one adverse or lifecycle case before improving presentation.

starterCode.code: class RemoteNewsSourceTest { private val server = MockWebServer() }

solutionOutline: Model immutable inputs, outputs, events, and failures at the boundary.
Implement the smallest correct path and verify every success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic state or protocol tests.
Inspect the relevant accessibility, lifecycle, concurrency, or network boundary.
